rejected_rule.statement: A constructive trust can be created in more ways than one, including under Sections 90, 91, and 96 of the Trusts Ordinance.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: There are many other sections, namely, Sections 90 to 96 upon which a constructive trust could be created.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Sections 90 to 96 of the Trusts Ordinance
